title: Crypto Bridging Advisory - Bitcoin Loans
summary: Silver Oak Capital's Crypto Bridging Advisory page (SERP title 'Crypto Bridging Advisory - Bitcoin Loans') presents crypto bridging as a short-term loan secured against a portfolio of cryptocurrencies, letting the borrower raise cash without selling and keep the upside. Search results state it suits high-net-worth individuals, crypto investors and businesses holding digital assets; Bitcoin and Ethereum are the most commonly accepted assets; lenders often cap LTV at 60% or lower on strong portfolios because of volatility; and the product carries lower LTVs, higher rates and stricter margin-call requirements than traditional asset-backed lending. No pricing, fees, process steps, lender names, CTAs or regulatory wording for this page surfaced. The sibling Bitcoin Loans Advisory page gives a more conservative 30-50% LTV range, which contradicts the 60% figure. All wording below comes from the search tool's summaries of snippets, not from a direct read of the page.
